name: Furuei Jin
source:
Name: Jin Furue
Sex: Male
Age: 29
Birthday: Aug 29
Profession: Businessman, Writer
Likes: Unknown
Dislikes: Unknown
Hobbies: Unknown
Skills: Unknown

[Past]
CEO of Music Food Co., Ltd. He held high positions at various other enterprises. He was also a writer and had released some of his essays to the media. His right half was found at Studio Dvaita.
[Present]
Jin Furue was killed by Tearer 6 years ago. [spoiler]He had inoperable tumors in the right side of his body and constantly received organs from Uru, ultimately his face as well.[/spoiler]

[From the in-game character descriptions]

[spoiler]He is the illegitimate son of Chikara Horadori and Tokiko Shigure, adopted by the Furue family. The right half of his face is Uru's, but the left half is his original, bearing a %-shaped birthmark. Any official photos of Jin are photoshopped to appear just like Uru's original face. The right half of his body (the one that looks like Uru) was found in the Past, while his left half (bearing his original face) was stored away for 6 years and found in the Present.[/spoiler]
